description: Robot intervention ground truth for the hand layup demo. Each entry is a contiguous interval during which the human-in-the-loop teleoperator drove the robot through one skill. Skill ids and arg keys mirror tasks/hand_layup/config/robot_skills.json.

interventions.rationale: Resin needed at workplace before human can pour into cup.
Hardener needed at workplace once resin pour is underway.
All four resined layers placed; force-controlled roller consolidates the stack.
Cleanup: human returns resin manually, robot returns hardener.

notes: Skills with no parameters carry an empty args object; this mirrors the program-only skills in robot_skills.json. Picking/returning of hardener vs resin is split between robot and human in this recording — only the robot-driven half appears here.
